reasons.1: Clean illustrated material planes and restrained grain fit F04, although the rounded, polished modeling is less planar than the anchor figure.
reasons.2: Reads as a young woman with tied dark curls and sun-browned skin; one diagonal satchel harness, one waist belt, left-hip olive bag and right-hand plain ferruled staff match, but faint repeated geometric motifs occupy the navy chest and lower tabard panels, and a shallow central chin dimple appears visible.
reasons.3: Staff ferrule, hair and facial highlights support a screen-upper-left key with readable cool garment shadows and no floor shadow or spell emission, though the overall fill is brighter and warmer than the prescribed deep cool ambient.
reasons.4: At a mentally reduced 64-px height the tied curly hair mass and separate upright staff remain legible, but the tiny brass tip merges into the thin shaft and individual curls disappear.
reasons.5: Controlled painted edges and low grain broadly match the anchors, with smoother skin, glossier leather and more finely modeled curls than F04's restrained figure brushwork.

ornament_surfaces: Navy tabard chest: faint tone-on-tone angular geometric patterning rather than a fully plain surface; no discrete central emblem.
Navy tabard lower front and side panels: repeated low-contrast angular/diamond-like motifs.
candidates.chin_cleft_or_dimple: A shallow central chin dimple appears present; subtle shading makes this less certain than the clothing observations.
